title: PlanBundle
description: Output of the Planner worker: deterministic page plan with claim assignments.

page_role.description: Role of the page (e.g. overview, installation, getting-started).

skeleton.description: Ordered list of section headings forming the page skeleton.

assigned_claims.description: Claim IDs assigned to this page.

assigned_snippets.description: Snippet indices assigned to this page.

frontmatter.description: Hugo frontmatter fields for this page.

mandatory.description: Whether this page is mandatory for the current launch tier.

content_path.description: Relative path for the generated content file.

skeleton_variant.description: Template variant used for skeleton selection.

target_class.description: Primary API class this page targets (for per-module pages).

golden_unmatched_sections.description: TC-3881 Wave 3 (G7): Section headings with no golden counterpart.

claim_saturation.description: TC-3876: Ratio of assigned claims to skeleton sections. <0.5 = thin page.

richness_tier.description: TC-3876: Richness tier (A/B/C) propagated from planner for tier-aware generation.

code_evidence_sparse.description: TR-01: True when example_files + extracted_snippets < 3. Triggers EVIDENCE ABSENT prompt instruction in section_prompt.

claim_assignment_index.description: Maps each claim_id to the list of page_ids it is assigned to.
